# nemau storage container create

Create a container.

--object-lock makes stored versions immutable for the retention period. This
protects backups from ransomware: even a compromised key cannot erase what is
already written.

These options can only be set at creation. S3 does not allow object locking on
an existing bucket, so a container for immutable backups must be created with
it.

Retention modes:

```
GOVERNANCE   the platform can lift the lock (default)
COMPLIANCE   nobody can lift the lock before it expires, the platform included
```

## Usage

```
nemau storage container create <name> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --object-lock             make versions immutable (implies --versioning)
      --retention-days int      how long objects stay immutable, in days
      --retention-mode string   GOVERNANCE (default) or COMPLIANCE
      --versioning              keep previous versions of objects
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
